question: What is the current Singapore weekday reconciliation deadline?

claims.text: The Singapore weekday batch reconciliation deadline is 18:00 SGT.

supports.quote: For Singapore weekday batches the deadline is 18:00 SGT; weekend batches have no same-day deadline.

uncertainties: Synthesized from current authorized evidence; exact supporting quotes and a separate model review were checked. Model review can miss errors; verify important conclusions.

evidence.title: reconciliation / Batch deadline
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
For Singapore weekday batches the deadline is 18:00 SGT; weekend batches have no same-day deadline.

evidence.title: reconciliation / Old operating note
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
The old 17:00 deadline applies only to the retired September pilot, not current weekday batches.

evidence.title: reconciliation / Ownership decision
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
Mina owns reconciliation exceptions; the platform team owns ingestion failures.

evidence.title: integration / USD exception
evidence.text:

Singapore business USD accounts require a separate connector approval; SGD approval does not include USD.

evidence.title: reconciliation / Missing input
evidence.text:

A batch with missing bank files must remain Pending, not be marked reconciled.

evidence.title: reconciliation / Pilot blocker
